newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends higher to reflect London's rally.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends higher to reflect London's rally.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price rose 11 cents to close at 14.47 ringgit ($5.85) a kg, in tandem with an overnight rally on the London Metal Exchange, traders said.
"The rise was basically because of the London market, there were no other visible factors," said a trader.
There were initial bids for 133 tonnes against offers for 121. Final turnover was 137 tonnes against 147 on Wednesday, and was absorbed by European, Japanese and local interests.
The local premium against London widened to $15 from $10 previously.
